milestone.describes: The main menu is drawn and stays up: the title art with PLAY, RESUME, SOCIAL, SCORES and HELP down the right-hand side, the whole frame rendered the right way up and the right way round. The steps past it reach live play, which is further than the rating goes: see the note for why that is not three stars yet.

steps.expect: The main menu: Fieldrunners title art with PLAY, RESUME, SOCIAL, SCORES and HELP stacked on the right.
The menu is still there and the app has not stopped. Its log keeps ticking drawables, so it is running rather than frozen at the last frame it managed. This is the two-star milestone.
SELECT YOUR MAP: Grasslands unlocked, Crossroads and Drylands locked, three more to buy, and a close X at the top right.
The tile lights up and the CUSTOMIZE screen opens: the map's name and description, EASY/MEDIUM/HARD, the Classic/Extended/Endless modes, and a Start button.
The level, with the tutorial overlay over it: money, lives, the pause and settings buttons, the tower prices, and 'Touch the screen to begin play'.
The overlay clears and Round 1 starts.
Runners are crossing: the round number climbs and the lives count falls.
Still running twenty seconds later - by here it has reached Round 3 and lost seven lives, so the loop is live rather than a held frame.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 480x320 landscape window. A capture includes the window border and title bar, so a position read off a frame is about (8, 31) out.
No launch options are needed: the app declares iPhone only and comes up landscape by itself.

This build reached the menu for the first time on `e643eb3e`, and live play on `d387265f`. Before that it aborted tapHLE during start-up, because it moves a directory and moving a directory was not implemented.

**Everything past the menu needs a fresh profile, and the reason is not understood yet.** With `Documents/default.sav` present the Grasslands tile stops responding - the tap that opens Customize on a fresh profile changes nothing at all, three runs in a row, while the same tap works every time once the save is deleted. Delete `tapHLE_sandbox/com.subatomicstudios.Fieldrunners` in the replay's working directory before replaying, and see the app note: a game that cannot be replayed after it has been played once is a compatibility problem in its own right.
**Live play is not the three-star milestone here.** The playing field itself does not draw: the HUD, the runners and the overlays appear over white. See `compatibility/notes/fieldrunners.md`.
The log fills with `Call to faked class "OpenFeint"` lines every frame. That is the social-network SDK being absent rather than anything going wrong, and it is what the SOCIAL button leads to.
